goal: Prepare a source-reviewed comparison of AX Engine Flash Next with oMLX, MTPLX and ds4 on the Ultra-class 192 GiB+ target. This is not an executable benchmark harness.
note: Source review establishes CLI and format differences only. Commands and exact-pack peer compatibility remain unvalidated; host resources and tools on PATH cannot establish readiness. No qualification or performance result is recorded.

target_host.description: Mac Studio, Ultra-class Apple Silicon (M2 Ultra or newer), 192 GiB or more

pack.format: MXFP4/group32 with per-tensor affine overrides and a BF16 MTP sidecar

fixed_conditions.stream_experts_rationale: Auto pages when the pack requires it or full_resident + 48 GiB exceeds host memory. Do not infer required paging from the family name or target RAM alone; record the actual manifest and decision.
fixed_conditions.disable_prefix_cache_confound: Disable logical and native prefix reuse for the uncached matrix, verify reuse counters, and record cold start separately. An OS-warm repeat is not proof of KV reuse; any cache experiments need separately labeled cells.

peers.role: Model-directory server; same-pack execution remains unvalidated
peers.blocker: The reviewed CLI uses serve --model-dir for a model directory. The pinned AX MXFP4 pack has not been qualified through this loader.

peers.role: Independent qwen4_exp graph with pack-specific loading conventions
peers.blocker: The reviewed public CLI uses run and serve; --mtp is a flag. The graph has its own ngram-sidecar and weight-sanitization conventions. Exact AX MXFP4 pack compatibility is unvalidated.

peers.role: Separate GGUF runtime; not a same-artifact AX safetensors baseline
peers.blocker: The reviewed Qwen path consumes a GGUF file and uses --mtp. The AX safetensors directory cannot be passed as that GGUF. A different pack needs separate checkpoint and quantization provenance.

ax_arm.command_scope: Server startup illustration only; requires a measured request harness, identity checks and explicit token inputs

reported_numbers_policy: No numbers or speedup may be inferred from this preparation audit. Exact-pack execution and timing protocols must be validated before a runnable comparison contract can replace it.
